Name: Stardew Valley - GRIND MODE
Author: MoorTarPetal
Description:
You want grind? Every part of the game has been changed in some way to make game harder and tone down all of the OP mechanics.
[u][b]Spoilers
[/b][/u]Changes:
﻿
[spoiler]
﻿(This is not an exhaustive list!)
﻿Friendship point gain is halved
﻿Low value loved gifts have been demoted to liked and low value liked gifts have been removed
﻿The threshold for actions gaining you skill has been increased and skill points gained reduced
﻿Sprinklers have been made rare
﻿Mine elevator does not work, mine prizes reduced in value
﻿The hot springs do not recover energy
﻿Stumps/logs no longer drop hardwood
﻿Bee houses require more flowers to be flavored
﻿Everything now needs to be unlocked, Vanilla unlock requirements increased
﻿Weapons have been scaled based on level and monsters have double damage, halved health, OP weapons have been reduced
﻿Slower farm animals
Tip Channel changes﻿
﻿Crafting recipes removed / locked
﻿Building is more expensive
﻿Fish are rarer, prices scaled to reflect rarity, difficulty of location and chance to dash
﻿A different machine system where input requirements are based on the size of the object
﻿Machines are more powerful but much more expensive
﻿Repriced crops and machine outputs to reflect delay, level and complexity of the recipe
﻿Readjusted stamina of cooking objects to reflect level and complexity of recipe, cooking recipes changed
﻿Purchased food no longer exploitable
﻿Starting tools are not given automatically
﻿Fruit trees / tea bushes have a different growing system and bear fruit in an unequal distribution
﻿Paddy and flower crops receive penalties to their crop value
﻿Some items now need to be ordered to either be collected in-store or to be mailed at a later date
﻿Some chance of randomization with crop maturity, crop penalties for growing crops out of season
﻿Higher bundle requirements
﻿Resolves the conflicting objects from different mods
﻿...and more!....
﻿[/spoiler]
*Conditions will vary depending on level of grindiness set
[b][u]Compatibility
[/u][/b]Effort has been made to make this mod as overwrite-able as possible (where I'm able to!). If you prefer the tweaks from one of the other difficulty mods out there you can change it!
